# Tendai Makoni Beach

> Official website of Tendai Makoni Beach, a Zambian gospel artist, worship leader, vocalist, recording artist, and music evangelist.

- Site: https://tendaimakonimusic.com
- Music: https://tendaimakonimusic.com/music
- Contact WhatsApp: +260 961776878
- Email: tendaimakonimusic@gmail.com

## Identity

Tendai Makoni Beach is a proud Zambian of Zimbabwean heritage. She is married to Minister Aaron Beach, an American teacher, author, and gospel minister. She founded My Heart for Worship, a ministry platform dedicated to helping people encounter God's love and presence through authentic worship.

On November 29, 2026, Tendai and her husband welcomed their daughter, Aariyella Lwendo Beach.

She is also a Communications & Public Relations Specialist, leadership coach, events planner, entrepreneur, and culinary enthusiast.

In 2022 she served as a backup singer for gospel artist Sinach.

## Music

Official singles:

- Tendayi Wedding Song (featuring Aaron Beach, March 2026)
- Fulfill (August 2025)
- Twalilila / Heal Our Land (2022)
- Isaiah 60 (January 2023)
- The Greater Love Christmas Medley (December 2023)

Streaming is available on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, and Boomplay.

## Ministry

My Heart for Worship exists so young and old can encounter God's love and presence through true worship.

## Merchandise

Faith-inspired items for local order in Lusaka, Zambia: Fulfill Mug (Isaiah 55:11), Lesa Mukulu Mug (Jeremiah 1:12), and Fulfill T-shirt.
